newsitem.title: CHINA: China listed firms' results to improve in 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: China listed firms' results to improve in 2nd half.

text.p: China's listed companies should post improved results in the second half of the year compared to the first half, the China Securities newspaper said on Saturday.

It said all of the 413 firms listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges had completed the issue of their interim results on time, and the quality of the reports was much better than in previous years.
The deadline was the end of August.
The paper said the financial state of the companies as reflected in their reports was "largely in line with expectations".

"Experts and investors believe that given the continuing improvement in the overall economic situation, there are reasons to believe results in the second half of the year will be better," the paper said.
Many of the listed companies have issued disappointing first-half results.
"The quality of the information in the reports this time was better than previously, with an improvement in both the nature and the quantity of the information disclosed," the newspaper added.
